newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek WPI inflation rises to 6.4pct in July.
newsitem.headline: Greek WPI inflation rises to 6.4pct in July.

text.p: Greece's wholesale price inflation rose to 6.4 percent year-on-year in July from 6.2 percent in June but was lower than the 6.7 percent figure in July 1995, the National Statistics Service (NSS) said in a statement.

The WPI index fell 0.6 percent month-on-month in July after dropping 1.7 percent month-on-month in June and 0.8 percent in July a year ago, it said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
